critical_code_review_comments: server.py still uses deprecated FastAPI @app.on_event('startup'/'shutdown'); use lifespan handlers.
CORS: allow_origins falls back to '*' when CORS_ORIGINS unset while allow_credentials=True. Browsers ignore the credential in that case but explicit origins list is safer for production.
No brute-force lockout on /auth/login and /auth/driver-register. Playbook expects lockout after 5 fails — not implemented.

assign_driver does not check driver.status=='approved' — an admin could assign a pending driver via API (UI list already filters). Consider adding server-side guard: if driver['status']!='approved' raise 400.
driver_available_jobs filters out jobs where the driver already has a request; consider also filtering when booking.status != 'confirmed' after a race (already done).
